intro: Pamela works at the Copenhagen Tourist Office. A tourist has questions. Listen to the dialogue!

hvor.consejo: «hv» is pronounced approximately «v»; in this word the r does not sound like a Spanish erre.

bor.consejo: The r is vocalized and modified the final sound; it is not pronounced as a Spanish erre. «Bo-a» is indicative.

kongen.consejo: «ng» is a watch n, like «bank» n; a separate g is not added.

konge.consejo: «ng» is a watch n, like «bank» n; a separate g is not added.

har.consejo: The r does not sound like a Spanish erre; it modifies the vocal. This approach is indicative.

ingen.consejo: The initial vowel is approaching «e»; «ng» is a watch n, without a separate g.

dronning.consejo: The r is articulated at the back of the mouth; «ng» is a watch n, without a separate g.

hvad.consejo: The h is mute; the d may not be heard or sound very soft according to pronunciation.

hedder.consejo: The dd sounds like the soft d of «Nothing.»; -er final = «a».

her.consejo: Orientation approach: the r is integrated into the vocal; it is not pronounced as a Spanish erre.

ja.consejo: The Danish j sounds like «and» of «I».

vinteren.consejo: The initial vowel approaches «e»; in this word «nt» is articulated with a soft d and the termination is reduced.

sommeren.consejo: The atone vowels are reduced; you do not pronounce a Spanish erre in the termination.

nærheden.consejo: The r modifies the vowel and does not sound like a Spanish erre; the d is gently articulated.

i nærheden af.consejo: In «nærheden», the r modifies the vowel; in this expression, the final f of «af» is not clearly pronounced.

af.consejo: In this preposition the final f is not clearly pronounced; the Danish vocal does not exactly amount to the Spanish «a».

er.consejo: Orientation approach: the r is integrated into the vocal, without a separate Spanish erre.

det.consejo: The final t does not sound: «de».

cirka.consejo: The r modifies the vocal and does not sound like a Spanish erre; the «sia-ka» guide is approximate.

kilometer.consejo: The atone vowels are reduced; the t of this word sounds like a soft d.

nord.consejo: The r is vocalized; the d is not heard in this word. «No.» is an approach.

syd.consejo: and approaches a «i» with rounded lips; the final d is fricative and soft.

øst.consejo: ø approaches a «e» with rounded lips; the final t sounds like a soft d.

vest.consejo: The vowel is open and the final t sounds like a soft d.

for.consejo: The r modifies the vowel; it is not pronounced as a Spanish erre. «Fo-a» is an approach.

mod.consejo: The final d is pronounced softly, similar to the d of «Nothing.».

hvordan.consejo: «hv» approaches «v»; a separate vibrant r is not heard and the d of the tonic syllable is pronounced.

hvorfor.consejo: «hv» approaches «v»; the r modifies the vowels and does not sound like a Spanish erre.

hvornår.consejo: «hv» approaches «v»; å is an open «or» and the r is integrated into the final vocal.

hvis.consejo: «hv» approaches «v»; the i of this word sounds close to «e».

hver.consejo: The h is mute; the r is integrated into the vocal and does not sound like a Spanish erre.

ved.consejo: The final d is greatly weakened in this word; the «Go» approach is indicative.

ikke.consejo: The kk sounds soft, almost a g.

huset.consejo: The h is pronounced with a soft aspiration; the final t is articulated as a soft d.

kommer.consejo: The final -er sounds like a short «a».

aften.consejo: The t of this word is articulated as a soft d.

søster.consejo: ø approaches a «e» with rounded lips; «st» sounds approximately «sd» and the termination is atone.

martins.consejo: The r is not articulated as a vibrant Spanish erre; this guide is indicative.

frases.estructura: Interrogativo + verbo + sujeto. Sin «do» como en inglés: igual que en español.

frases.da: Vi har en konge i Danmark. Han hedder Frederik.
frases.es: Tenemos un rey en Dinamarca. Se llama Frederik.
frases.en: We have a king in Denmark. His name is Frederik.
frases.literal: We have a king in Denmark.

frases.en: Do you live here in Copenhagen?
frases.estructura: Pregunta de sí/no: el verbo va primero.

frases.da: Ja, om vinteren. Om sommeren bor han i nærheden af Hillerød.
frases.es: Sí, en invierno. En verano vive cerca de Hillerød.
frases.en: Yeah, in winter. In summer he lives near Hillerød.
frases.literal: In summer he lives in the vicinity of Hillerød.
frases.estructura: La frase empieza por «Om sommeren», así que, para mantener el verbo en segunda posición, «bor» precede al sujeto: «bor han».

frases.da: Hvor ligger Hillerød? Er det her på Sjælland?
frases.en: Where's Hillerød? Is he here in Selandia?
frases.estructura: «Ligge» se usa habitualmente para expresar dónde está situado un lugar; no se traduce literalmente como «yacer». «Være» también aparece en preguntas de lugar, como «Er det her på Sjælland?».

frases.da: Ja, cirka tyve kilometer nord for København.
frases.es: Sí, a unos veinte kilómetros al norte de Copenhague.
frases.en: Yeah, about 20 kilometers north of Copenhagen.

filas: **Det er** en ø. («Det» retoma la pregunta «Hvad er Fyn?».)
**Det ved jeg ikke.** = No lo sé.
bloques.nota: The next lesson explains how to recognize whether a noun is **en** or **et** type. They are also natural short responses like **Nord for København**.

bloques.texto:
In Danish, the **h** is usually pronounced with a light aspiration. It is mute in the **hv** and **hj** groups:

- **hv**or → approximately «vor»
- **hj**em → approximately «yem»

Do not extend this rule to other words: the h is heard in **han** and **hus**.

bloques.audio: Hillerød ligger cirka tyve kilometer nord for København.

opciones.En Jutlandia: Está en Sjælland, cerca de Copenhague.

bloques.audio: Vi har en konge i Danmark. Han hedder Frederik.

La frase afirma que sí hay un rey.
La frase solo dice que hay un rey en Dinamarca.

bloques.correcta: Tenemos un rey en Dinamarca. Se llama Frederik.

frases.da: Pamela rejser til København hver dag.
frases.es: Pamela va a Copenhague cada día.
frases.en: Pamela goes to Copenhagen every day.

frases.estructura: La edad, con «være»: Hun er 16 år.

bloques.pregunta: Listen. What would you ask to know more?

opciones.Hvornår?: ¿Cuándo? → I næste uge (la semana que viene).

bloques.pregunta: Listen. What sentence do you respond to?

Tienen dos hijos. ¿Quiénes? Jørgen y Pamela.
